Congress Protests Punjab Government's 'Failures'

The Congress party in Punjab is organizing a protest against the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government led by Bhagwant Mann. The protest is scheduled to be led by Raja Warring. The Congress alleges that the Mann government has failed in its governance. Details regarding the specific failures cited by the Congress were not fully elaborated in the provided coverage, but the protest aims to highlight these alleged shortcomings. The timing and exact location of the protest were also not specified.
